propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling at 32767 (WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT) despite jira.text.field.character.limit being admin-configurable on DC with range 0 to 2147483647
when a DC admin raises or removes the comment limit, rebar silently truncates comments that Jira would accept, causing permanent divergence between local and remote bodies
the 32767 default is correct for stock Jira 7.0+ but wrong for configured instances, creating a data-loss window only discoverable if the operator knows their instance setting
comment sanitization was coupled to the description fitter (fit_outbound), risking future description-fitter changes from incorrectly retargeting comments
the endpoint /rest/api/2/application-properties/advanced-settings requires admin permission, making runtime discovery infeasible for rebar's ordinary-user PAT
configuration must be the sole remedy: make comment_max_chars settable per ReconcilerConfig, defaulting to 32767, with proper provenance documentation
